docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The stories told to the Mohawk poet by Chief Joe Capilano and others of the Squamish people about the lions, the Siwash Rock and the Two Sisters.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

E. Pauline Johnson (Tekahionwake, 1861–1913), Legends of Vancouver, 1911, with a foreword by Bernard McEvoy (1842–1932). This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution.
